data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word "Eve" meaning life or living. In the Bible, Eve is the first woman, created from Adam's rib, and is known for her temptation by the serpent in the Garden of Eden. Evelisse is a vibrant and beautiful name for a girl that carries the essence of life and new beginnings. The name Evelisse carries the meaning “Lively one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Evelisse usually hope their child will grow to embody lively one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
